ui.creditsBody:
Made for CAU computer science students.
Sprites drawn in code · Endesga 32 palette · sound synthesised live.
Font: Noto Sans Mono (SIL Open Font License).
Engine: Phaser 3 (MIT). Professors appear only under their in-game names.
MacCoffee and Nescafe appear as text only.
Visits and game milestones are counted anonymously (GoatCounter, no cookies).
ui.disclaimer: Unofficial student game · not affiliated with Central Asian University

quest: There is no continuous assessment here. Only a mid-term and a final {tic}.
They are both in the lab. They are both large. Off you go.
tip: Keep moving. A body at rest stays at rest, gets hit {tic}.
When it folds into a plane, look for the shadow and step out of it {tic}.
Save your coffee for when the extra sheets arrive {tic}.
The final is sixty percent. Treat it with sixty percent of your respect {tic}.
bark: Conservation of energy! Yours is running out {tic}.
That was not in the simulation.
assist: Time dilation. You have eight seconds, relativity {tic}.
win: Good. Results match the analytic prediction {tic}. Rare.
fail: Hm. Check your initial conditions {tic}. Again.
idle: MOSFETs, logic gates {tic}. It is all physics underneath.
Guided Independent Study is seventy hours. I counted {tic}.

quest: Welcome, welcome. Computer Programming. You will be fine.
There are quizzes, a small mid-term, a project and a final. The final is half. Don't worry about that.
Take semicolons. In C++ you will need all of them.
tip: Small quizzes first, they are quick. Then the thick lab reports.
When a project falls apart into pages, deal with the pages. I believe in you.
If your laptop says 'compiling', step back and wait. It is normal. It is always compiling.
You look stressed. I can tell. It is literally my research.
win: Wonderful! I knew you could. I would have passed you anyway.
fail: Oh. Well... you came, and that is what matters. Let's call it a C and move on, yes?
idle: Did everybody understand? Good. I will explain again anyway.
My office is 264. Come any time. Bring your error message.

tip: Do not stand in the corner. A corner is a local minimum.
The quizzes converge on you. Diverge.
The final is continuous. It does not stop. You also should not.
assist: Isometry. All distances are preserved. Five seconds.
fail: The proof has a gap. Once more.
idle: In a Banach space this would be easier.
Room 445. Bring the question, not only the answer.

students: Did he say the final is fifty percent?
I have no semicolons. I am a Python student.
The portal says 'No data'. For everything.
Bro, is the Wi-Fi working for you?
I started the project. I opened the file.
One MacCoffee and I can do anything. For forty minutes.
loadingTips: Starting before the deadline day is theoretically possible.
Guided Independent Study: 70 hours. Guided by whom is not specified.
Arrays start at 0. So does your motivation.
C++'s Semicolon is unlimited. Your Sanity is not.
Soggy paper is slow paper. Throw the coffee.
The final is half your grade. The other half is also the final, emotionally.
